strings.ANCHOR_NOTE: The one choice that decides what a missed period means.
strings.DATE_ONLY_REMINDER: Date only · it reminds at 09:00, the moment set in Settings — never midnight.
strings.DAY_ONE: Add the first thing you must not forget.
strings.EFFORT_NOTE_A: Feeds the “fits in 30 minutes” lens in Today.
strings.HOME_VAULT_NOTE_A: A task keeps the vault it was born in.
strings.MISSED_NOTE_B: Four missed periods collapse into it — never four copies.
strings.PENDING_CHIP: Saved on this device · queued for the vault
strings.PRIORITY_NOTE_B: Most tasks never take one, and no layout reserves room for it.
strings.PROMOTION_B: This is a project with sections now.
strings.REENTRY_FOOT_A: Releasing keeps them in the Logbook as won't do.
strings.REENTRY_FOOT_B: It is an outcome, not a failure.
strings.REENTRY_LEAD_A: Nothing was deleted and nothing repeated itself into a pile.
strings.REENTRY_LEAD_B: Move what still matters and release the rest.
strings.REENTRY_NONE: Nothing came due while you were away.
strings.REMINDER_NOTE_B: This seat says due-ness in the pane, never a push.
strings.SUBTASK_CAP: One level only · a subtask cannot have a subtask
strings.TAGS_NOTE_B: Removing deletes this task's edge only.
strings.TODAY_EMPTY_SUB: An undated task never lands here — Anytime holds those.
